name: COMPANION VETERINARY CLINIC
address: 3197 N HWY 97 ST A1, BEND, OR 97701

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can quickly identify the property from the road.
• Trim vegetation along the sides of the driveway to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to keep a clear path between it and the main residence.
• Keep a gate or opening in any fence along the rear of the property unlocked to allow responders to reach the rear on foot.
• Clear overgrown plants or shrubs from along the walkway so responders can move between the front and rear of the property without obstruction.
• Mark the location of the detached structure with a visible sign or reflective marker so arriving responders know a second structure is on the property.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so emergency vehicles have room to stage near the residence.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Open Green Space; Scattered Shrubs; Tree Cluster; Ground Vegetation; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or within a few feet of the roof and walls.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create gaps between the canopies.
• Remove scattered shrubs that are growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation growing close to the foundation and along the base of exterior walls.
• Keep the space beneath large trees near the structure free of dead leaves, fallen branches, and other loose material.
• Separate any shrubs that are close enough to touch or nearly touch the lower branches of nearby trees.
• Maintain the open green space areas by keeping grass and low plants mowed short, especially near the structure.
• Keep all access routes clear of low-hanging branches that could block or slow a vehicle.
• Remove dead or dry material from ground vegetation near any outbuildings or secondary structures on the property.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so that canopies do not touch or overlap each other.
